services.title: MVP in 4 Weeks
services.description: Stop waiting months to test your idea. I'll build and launch a fully functional Minimum Viable Product so you can start acquiring users and validating your market fast.

services.title: E-Commerce Optimization
services.description: Generic templates hurt conversion. I build bespoke, high-performance storefronts that can handle massive traffic spikes and provide a luxury shopping experience.

services.title: AI & Workflow Automation
services.description: Save hundreds of hours by automating repetitive tasks. I integrate AI models and connect your internal tools to work seamlessly together on autopilot.

story.problem: La Joie needed a digital ordering experience that could keep up with a fast-moving food truck bakery — making it effortless for customers to order while simplifying operations behind the scenes.
story.approach: I designed and developed the entire platform from scratch, pairing a conversion-focused storefront with a custom admin panel for managing products, orders, and day-to-day operations. I also built an analytics dashboard to turn sales data into actionable insights.
story.solution: A complete digital ecosystem that handles the full ordering journey — from discovering the menu and placing an order to managing operations and tracking business performance.

story.problem: Vogue Bakes needed a polished online presence where customers could easily explore its products, customize their orders, and place bakery orders without relying on manual ordering through social media or messages.
story.approach: I built the complete storefront from scratch, focusing on a premium product browsing experience, streamlined ordering flow, and a responsive interface that works seamlessly across devices.
story.solution: A modern bakery e-commerce platform that brings the entire ordering experience online, making it easier for customers to discover products and place orders while giving the business a scalable digital storefront.

story.problem: KraftyTales needed a simple yet premium way to showcase its curated gifting collection online while turning product interest into direct customer enquiries.
story.approach: I built a visually focused product catalog from scratch, designed to make browsing effortless and integrated each product with a direct WhatsApp enquiry flow, removing unnecessary friction between discovery and conversation.
story.solution: A lightweight digital catalog that showcases products beautifully and converts browsing into direct WhatsApp enquiries, giving the brand a simple and effective way to generate orders online.

endorsements.quote: Having Saksham run the technical infrastructure is a game-changer. The storefront just works, even during traffic spikes, and looks incredibly premium.
endorsements.author: Lakshay

endorsements.quote: From our first meeting to the final launch, collaborating with Saksham was a great experience. The end result is a premium site that perfectly captures our brand identity.
endorsements.author: Sneha
